# > on an integer field never matches NULL ages
age > 30

# >= includes the bound
age >= 30

# < with a signed negative number
age < 0

# <= on an integer field
age <= 17

# = on an integer field
age = 30

# A quoted number on an integer field still compares numerically
age > '60'

# A quoted identifier names the same field
"age" >= 61

# > on a float field
height > 1.8

# <= on a float field, where 1.6 is stored as a double
height <= 1.6

# > on a numeric field
balance > 1000

# Numeric equality ignores trailing zeros: 15 equals 15.00
balance = '15.00'

# = on a boolean field
active = FALSE

# = on an enum field
plan = 'team'

# = on a uuid field
uid = '00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000003'

# > on a date field
due > '2026-11-02'

# < on a timestamp field with an explicit offset
created_at < '2024-01-01T00:00:00Z'

# A date string is not a timestamp; only relative dates cover a whole day
created_at = '2026-10-27'

# A field from a lateral join
order_count >= 3

# A timestamp from a lateral join
last_order_at > '2026-10-27T09:00:00+00:00'
